cohort: 367 neonates admitted to public hospitals in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
finding: Neonatal Near Miss (NNM) prevalence was 25.6% and was associated with the mother's work, previous preterm deliveries, Cesarean section, pregnancy-related hypertension, and infection.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with NNM (AOR 2.39, 95% CI: 1.229-4.652).
